project.readme: CubeSolve is a Python-based Rubik's Cube Solver and 3D Visualizer. Supports 3x3 to NxN cubes with multiple solving algorithms (LBL, CFOP, Kociemba, Cage) and rendering backends (Pyglet, Tkinter, Console, Headless, Web).

solvers.name: LBL
solvers.preview: Beginner Layer-By-Layer solver. Simple visual approach.

solvers.name: CFOP
solvers.preview: Fridrich method (Cross, F2L, OLL, PLL). Advanced, faster.

solvers.name: Cage
solvers.preview: Big cube solver using reduction method.

architecture: Layered architecture: Domain (model, algs, solver, geometric) -> Application (app, state, operator, animation) -> Presentation (gui backends, 3D viewer).

test_info.testing_guide: pytest (with pytest-xdist for parallel). Markers: slow, benchmark, gui, console. Test dirs: solvers/, algs/, performance/, gui/, backends/, console/.
